definitions.explanation: The body's ability to fight off disease, infection, or harmful influences. Also used figuratively for the ability to withstand adverse conditions.

examples.japanese: {抵抗力|ていこうりょく}が{落|お}ちている。
{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}は{抵抗力|ていこうりょく}を{弱|よわ}める。
examples.english: Lack of sleep weakens your immunity.

examples.japanese: {栄養|えいよう}バランスのよい{食事|しょくじ}をとることで、{病気|びょうき}に{対|たい}する{抵抗力|ていこうりょく}を{高|たか}めることができる。
examples.english: By eating a well-balanced diet, you can boost your resistance to disease.

notes:
Composed of {抵抗|ていこう} (resistance) + {力|りょく} (power, ability). Most commonly used in health and medical contexts to refer to the body's natural defense mechanisms against illness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抵抗力|ていこうりょく}を{高|たか}める: to boost resistance/immunity
- {抵抗力|ていこうりょく}が{落|お}ちる: resistance drops
- {抵抗力|ていこうりょく}が{弱|よわ}い: to have weak resistance
- {抵抗力|ていこうりょく}をつける: to build up resistance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {免疫力|めんえきりょく}: immune strength — more specifically about the immune system
- {体力|たいりょく}: physical strength, stamina — broader, covering overall physical fitness
- {耐性|たいせい}: tolerance, resistance — used for drug resistance or acquired tolerance
